objects.name: risk
objects.description: One thing an organisation has decided could go badly wrong, drawn as a bow-tie, with someone accountable for it.

objects.name: pathway
objects.description: One way a risk could come about, or one way its consequences unfold.

objects.name: control
objects.description: One measure the organisation operates to stop, detect or limit something going wrong.

objects.name: barrier
objects.description: A control standing on one pathway, and how well it is judged to hold there.

objects.name: evidence
objects.description: A test, log, audit or incident that shows whether a barrier works.

objects.name: assessment
objects.description: A dated rating of how likely a risk is and how serious it would be.

objects.name: action
objects.description: A piece of work, with an owner and a date, to close a gap.
